blocks.text: Soonghne ki hiss (olfaction) naak ki cavities ke oopar wale hisse ke chemoreceptors se aati hai. Yeh receptors patle tissue, nasal epithelium, mein sensory neurons ke sire hain, jo supporting cells (hifazat karne wale) aur basal cells (purane neurons badalne wale stem cells) ke darmiyan bhare hain.

items: In neurons ke dendrites nanhe baal jaise cilia par khatam hote hain jo naak ki cavity ki geeli mucus mein nikle hote hain.
Hawa ke kimiyai madde mucus mein ghul kar cilia ki khaas receptor jagahon se judte hain.
Yeh judna impulses banata hai jo olfactory nerves (cranial nerve I) se olfactory bulb tak jate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: zaban ki sateh mein laga piyaz-numa taste bud, lambe receptor cells jin ke baal jaise sire taste pore tak jate hain, neeche basal cells aur sensory nerve ke resha. Daen: haddi ki plate ke oopar olfactory bulb; olfactory neurons surmai supporting cells ke beech se haddi paar karte hain aur un ke cilia mucus ki teh mein hain jahan hawa ke boo wale molecules ghulte hain.
blocks.caption: Boo ke receptors (Figure 15.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Taste buds (taqreeban 10,000) chemoreceptors hain, zyada tar zaban ke papillae ke darmiyan; har aik taste pore se khulta aur us mein receptor cells aur unhein badalne wale basal cells hote hain. Khurak ke kimiyai madde receptor cells ko jagate aur impulses cranial nerves VII, IX aur X ke zariye brainstem aur phir cerebral cortex ke zaiqe wale hisson tak jate hain. Boo ke receptors nasal epithelium mein sensory neurons ke sire hain, supporting cells aur basal cells ke darmiyan; boo ke madde mucus mein ghul kar cilia se judte, aur impulses olfactory nerve (cranial nerve I) se olfactory bulb tak jate hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai olfactory bulb boo ka ehsas paida karta hai. Bulb signals ko process kar ke aage bhejta hai; boo ka shaoori ehsas cerebrum ke olfactory cortex mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Jo madda naak ki mucus mein na ghule us ki boo kyun nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: Boo ke maddon ko cilia ki receptor jagahon tak pohanch kar judne ke liye mucus mein ghulna zaroori hai; judne ke baghair impulse nahi banta.

items: Boo: nasal epithelium mein neurons ke sire; mucus mein cilia ghule maddon se judte; impulses nerve I se olfactory bulb tak.
